items.title: UMG v. Suno II: majors push back on Suno's stay motion, seek only a 'partial' pause pending discovery fight
items.excerpt: Universal Music v. Suno II is intensifying as the major labels and the AI platform clash over the case's discovery scope; the majors push back against Suno's stay motion and seek only a 'partial' pause.

items.title: Elvis Presley Enterprises and Authentic Brands Group file amended, expanded Suno copyright and NIL suit
items.excerpt: Elvis Presley Enterprises, Authentic Brands Group and co-plaintiffs have filed an amended and expanded infringement and name-and-likeness complaint against AI music generator Suno, adding new claims. (Original suit covered 11-08; this is a new filing.)

items.title: Kanye West's Bully up for Best Rap Album at 2027 Grammys after AI controversies
items.excerpt: Kanye West's Bully, an album dogged by AI controversies, has been nominated for Best Rap Album at the 2027 Grammy Awards.

items.title: Kanye West's Bully up for Best Rap Album Grammy despite A.I. allegations
items.excerpt: Widespread allegations of A.I. use did not deter Grammy voters from nominating Ye's critically dismissed LP Bully for Best Rap Album. (Same story as Consequence; alternate source.)

items.title: Vibe coding is changing how musicians customize their gear
items.excerpt: AI is changing just about every industry, even music: how musicians are using vibe coding to alter their sound, their gear and how music is made. (Trend overlaps Verge 10-20 piece.)

items.title: Initial Audio updates Difro Melody AI to v2.5 with local audio-to-MIDI and a VST3/AU plugin
items.excerpt: Difro Melody AI 2.5 converts dragged-in melodic loops of up to 16 bars to MIDI locally, then generates variations with Re-Imagine; it now runs as a VST3/AU plugin with DAW sync and realtime MIDI/audio output. Free tier with limited generations, Pro unlimited.

items.title: AI music used in Somerset carnival processions 'disappointing'
items.excerpt: Some clubs at Bridgwater Carnival, the UK's oldest, soundtracked their illuminated carts with AI-generated music, dividing opinion among local musicians and carnival-goers. (Off-list: no on-list outlet covered it.)

items.title: Muse's Matt Bellamy wants an AI guitar: 'talking to your guitar and telling it how to sound'
items.excerpt: Matt Bellamy says he'd like an AI-powered guitar that changes its tone on spoken command, while arguing AI won't replace human-made art because his kids gravitate to 'the real'. (Off-list; interview/opinion.)

items.title: Universal Music Group's CEO on how labels need to drown out the cacophony of AI slop
items.excerpt: While many complain about AI slop, it is finding its way into the music charts; UMG's CEO on what music labels and digital service providers can do to hold back the tide. (Off-list.)

items.title: ARIA and PPCA launch 'Not AI's to Take' campaign for permission-first AI copyright rules in Australia
items.excerpt: Australia's recording-industry bodies ARIA and PPCA lead a cross-sector campaign urging Canberra to reject an opt-out text-and-data-mining exception and require AI companies to obtain consent before training on music and other creative works. (Off-list; date-only, page shows 17 Nov.)

items.title: 루게릭병으로 목소리 잃은 가수, 뇌 신호로 다시 노래했다
items.excerpt: 루게릭병 환자의 뇌 신호를 전극으로 수집해 AI로 음성으로 변환하는 기술로, 감정·억양에 노래까지 구현했고 단어 인식 정확도는 94%에 달한다. (Off-list; body JS-gated, from og:description.)

items.title: MusicRWKV: A Multimodal RWKV Framework for Music Representation Learning
items.excerpt: arXiv paper (cs.SD/eess.AS) proposing a multimodal RWKV framework for music representation learning. Excerpt from title only; abstract not yet read.

items.title: Evaluating AI Musical Creativity: a quantitative multi-dimensional framework based on value, novelty and surprise
items.excerpt: arXiv paper proposing a quantitative, multi-dimensional framework for evaluating AI musical creativity based on value, novelty and surprise. Excerpt from title only.
